column1: # Bahrain, the Supreme Council for Islamic Affairs: one table for the kingdom, its 1448 calendar book
# (16 Jun 2026 to 5 Jun 2027; authorities-arab-world-turkiye.md). Fajr and sunrise for the kingdom's
# easternmost point, Dhuhr to Isha for its westernmost. The engine computes at the Hawar islands'
# east (the method's fixed point: lat and lon empty) and Umm an Nasan's west coast (a start point)
# beside the user's own point, so the table is checked there and at the app's eight Bahraini towns,
# since the whole kingdom follows it. The fast begins at the printed Fajr (F+E). Standard Asr.
# One year for one table, whose days the margins are fitted on: fit, nothing held out.
